runtime_notes: mojekarte.si search works with plain curl at /si/iskanje.html?searchword=<term> and returns performer or event group pages at /si/skupina/<id>/<slug>.html with every date, venue and price. The earlier /sl/iskanje path returned 404.

mojekarte.si genre page https://www.mojekarte.si/si/zanr/50/otroci-druzina.html lists 75 children and family events with date, venue and price, readable with plain curl. Pages 2 to 5 are at /si/zanr/50/otroci-druzina/<page>-1-1-1.html. Each event has a /si/<slug>/vstopnice-<id>.html page with venue, price and organiser. This is the best new calendar from this session. The ?page= parameter is ignored.
Eventim search at eventim.si/en/search/?affiliate=EVE&searchterm=<term> works in the browser and lists artist events, but curl still fails. It returned no results for 'otroški koncert'.

Visit Ljubljana publishes a two-week event PDF at /assets/export/visitljubljana-prireditve-dva-tedna.pdf and a today PDF at /assets/export/visitljubljana-prireditve-danes.pdf. Plain curl works and pdftotext gives dated lines with venue and 'Vstop prost' markers.

Kino Šiška: the archive page shows only a 2026-09-19 event and the home page only MENT Ljubljana 2027 on 17 Feb. No Neca Falk event exists. Kino Šiška has no kids programme in the horizon on the pages read.
visitcelje.eu image PDF for Maksimilijanov dan: the 2026 edition was 10 and 12 October 2026, so it is past. The winter PDF found is the 2025 edition.

Tomos and veteran car season is over. The in-horizon items are club meetings. cars.coffee/slovenia is a demo page with no dates. zveza-svs.si/dogodki and zmks.com showed no dates for November to February.
Google result domains that kept showing up with readable calendars: dogodki-slovenija.si, vwoks.si, etno-muzej.si, mojekarte.si, topevent.si.
Queries not run: Tomos srečanje November and December 2026 as separate month queries, and Ta veseli dan kulture per museum beyond Cukrarna and Narodni muzej in the first pass.
